.. py:data:: HESSIAN_SIGMAS_DEFAULT
   :type:  tuple[float, Ellipsis]
   :value: (1.0, 3.0, 5.0, 7.0, 9.0)


.. py:function:: parse_sigmas(text: str | None, *, default: collections.abc.Sequence[float] = HESSIAN_SIGMAS_DEFAULT) -> tuple[float, Ellipsis]

   Parse comma/semicolon-separated sigma scales; empty → *default*.


.. py:function:: hessian_filter(image: nvitk.types.Image | numpy.ndarray, *, sigmas: collections.abc.Iterable[float] | collections.abc.Sequence[float] | None = None, black_ridges: bool = True, alpha: float = 0.5, beta: float = 0.5, gamma: float = 15.0, mode: str = 'reflect', cval: float = 0.0) -> nvitk.types.Image | numpy.ndarray

   Hybrid Hessian filter (skimage) for ridges / vessels in 2-D or 3-D.

   Thin wrapper around :func:`skimage.filters.hessian`. Prefer *black_ridges*
   for dark vessels on a bright background; set ``False`` for bright ridges
   (e.g. TOF / CD vessels).

   :param image: 2-D or 3-D intensity volume (:class:`~nvitk.types.Image` or ndarray).
   :param sigmas: Gaussian scales. Default ``(1, 3, 5, 7, 9)`` (skimage uses ``range(1, 10, 2)``).
   :param black_ridges: Detect dark ridges when True; bright ridges when False.
   :param alpha: Passed through to skimage (blob / plate / structure sensitivity).
   :param beta: Passed through to skimage (blob / plate / structure sensitivity).
   :param gamma: Passed through to skimage (blob / plate / structure sensitivity).
   :param mode: Boundary mode for Gaussian derivatives.
   :param cval: Boundary mode for Gaussian derivatives.
